title: Normalized tensor multiplication from etale quotient stalks
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $T$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and use ordinary module sheaves over the constant ring sheaf $A_T$ on a small representative of $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $E,D\subseteq |T|$ be subsets and let
$$q:A_T\twoheadrightarrow F,\qquad s:A_T\twoheadrightarrow G,\qquad r:A_T\twoheadrightarrow H$$
be epimorphisms of $A_T$-module sheaves. Assume $F$ is flat, meaning tensoring with $F$ preserves short exact sequences [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. For every geometric point $\bar t$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], assume given $A$-linear identifications
$$F_{\bar t}\cong\begin{cases}A&t\in E,\\0&t\notin E,\end{cases}\qquad
G_{\bar t}\cong\begin{cases}A&t\in D,\\0&t\notin D,\end{cases}\qquad
H_{\bar t}\cong\begin{cases}A&t\in E\cap D,\\0&t\notin E\cap D.\end{cases}$$
Under these identifications the stalk maps of $q,s,r$ are the identity of $A$ on their respective subsets and the zero map otherwise. Use sheaf tensor over $A_T$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and let
$$m:A_T\xrightarrow{\lambda^{-1}}A_T\otimes_{A_T}A_T\xrightarrow{q\otimes s}F\otimes_{A_T}G,$$
where $\lambda(a\otimes b)=ab$. Then $m$ is epic and there is a unique morphism $e:F\otimes_{A_T}G\to H$ with $e\circ m=r$. This morphism is an isomorphism and, for local sections $a,b$ of $A_T$, satisfies
$$e(q(a)\otimes s(b))=r(ab).$$
At $t\in E\cap D$ its stalk is $A\otimes_A A\to A$, $a\otimes b\mapsto ab$, with inverse $c\mapsto c\otimes1$; outside $E\cap D$ it is the unique map $0\to0$.

proof.text: Work directly with the existing sheafified tensor on A-module-valued sheaves. The geometric stalk functor is strong monoidal, as in [lem-pod-etale-stalk-tensor-scalar](1), with its canonical unit identification eta and tensor comparison mu (Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Point.Monoidal). For normalized identifications iF,iG, oplax naturality and unit coherence give stalk(m) followed by delta, iF tensor iG, and multiplication = eta. The latter three maps and eta are invertible, so stalk(m) is invertible on E intersect D. Off E intersect D one factor is zero, and the identity on its tensor is zero by additivity; mu therefore identifies the tensor stalk with a zero object.

Use the jointly faithful family of universe-lifted geometric stalks supplied by [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative] (the existing jointlyFaithful consequence for module coefficients). Every stalk of m is epic: it is invertible on the intersection, and has zero target outside it. If m followed by f equals m followed by g, stalkwise epimorphic cancellation gives equal stalk maps of f and g, hence f=g. Thus m is epic directly, without computing a cokernel.

Let k=kernel.ι(m). To show k followed by r is zero, check the lifted geometric stalks. On E intersect D, map(k) followed by map(m) is zero by the kernel equation, so map(k)=0 because map(m) is invertible. Outside the intersection, the target stalk of r is zero. Joint faithfulness gives k followed by r=0. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-exact-epi-cokernel](a), concretely ShortComplex.kernelSequence_exact and Exact.desc, to construct e0 with m followed by e0=r. This uses the existing abelian category of ModuleCat-valued sheaves; no change to a ringed-site module category is necessary.

On the intersection stalk(r) is invertible by its normalized identification and the invertible unit identification. The equation map(m) followed by map(e0)=map(r), with map(m) invertible, proves map(e0) invertible. Off the intersection both source and target stalks are zero, so map(e0) is invertible there too. Apply [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative] directly to the module-valued sheaf map e0 to obtain the required isomorphism e. Uniqueness among all maps follows by cancellation of the epic m.

The descent equation gives (q tensor s) followed by e.hom = lambda followed by r. Apply lax tensor naturality for the existing sheaf-to-presheaf functor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and evaluate its component on a tensor b. This gives exactly the displayed local-section formula, including locally constant sections of the tensor unit.

For any specified normalized iF,iG,iH on E intersect D, compare the normalization equation of the first step with map(m) followed by map(e.hom) followed by iH=eta. Cancel the epic map(m). Precomposing the resulting equality with mu and using mu followed by delta=id gives mu followed by map(e.hom) followed by iH = (iF tensor iG) followed by multiplication. Evaluate on iF.inv(a) tensor iG.inv(b) to get ab. For the asserted inverse formula, apply the injective map map(e.hom) followed by iH to both sides: the left becomes c by the inverse identities, and the right becomes c times 1=c by the multiplication formula. Off the intersection the already proved zero-stalk results imply the map is zero. The flatness and the three original epimorphism assumptions are retained unchanged; the normalized-stalk argument suffices.

Generic sheafification/tensor comparison applied to the constant ring presheaf, needed to match the two tensor conventions; no geometric argument of the unit is replaced.
Generic geometric-stalk tensor comparison with pure-tensor and unit normalization; the unit gives no substitute for this site-level tool.
Generic exact forgetting of module sheaves to abelian sheaves, needed for stalk tests on kernels and cokernels; not a cohomological route change.
Generic conservativity of geometric stalks for underlying abelian sheaves; used only to test zero sheaves, zero maps and the final isomorphism.

The statement and stmt_deps are identical to live, where the item is unsplit, and flatness is kept although unused. There are 0 new nodes. Each of the 7 steps checked against the statements it cites. (1) Constant-ring equivalence plus lem-pc-sites-module-sheafification-tensor (second clause) identify ⊗_{A_T} with the sheafified ⊗_A presheaf. (2) pod stalk-tensor (1) gives m_t(c)=q_t(c)⊗s_t(1): this is c↦c⊗1 on E∩D, with multiplication as its inverse, and B_t=0 elsewhere. (3) Module sheaves form an abelian category, and the exact faithful forgetful functor, exact stalks and conservativity give coker m=0, so m is epic. (4) r∘k has zero stalks, so it is zero. (5) The exact-epi cokernel lemma (a) gives the unique e. (6) e is an isomorphism by stalks plus conservativity, and the inverse is A_T-linear. (7) The section formula follows from bilinearity (elementary). Small cases tested: T empty, A=0, E=D=|T|, E∩D empty, and the asymmetric points. Sources checked: Stacks 03PU/03PT (etale-cohomology.tex l.3546/3456) and the sites-modules lemma-sheafification-tensor; no SGA source. Duplicate search over dag/nodes found no match; lem-sfb-integral-tensor-quotient-epimorphism is a different statement. The tool_uses are generic and accepted. Batch-5 flag on lem-pod-etale-stalk-tensor-scalar: it is generic sheaf algebra. Its 66-node closure contains no trace-formula node and no PD proof node; the only other pod node is def-pod-ring-scalar-extension. Accepted.
